name: March 7, 2024 Special Meeting - Youth Government Summit
agenda_text:
Harry Barovsky Memorial Youth Commission
  Special Meeting Agenda

  Thursday, March 7, 2024
  6:00 P.M.
  City Hall – Multipurpose Room
  23825 Stuart Ranch Road

Six p.m.  Special Meeting

Government Summit
The Harry Barovsky Memorial Youth Commission will hold a government summit to listen to
guest speakers. The Commission preselected questions for the speakers at its December 12, 2023,
Regular meeting. The community is invited to attend. Commissioners may be present to listen to
the presentation but will not discuss any business or take any action during this meeting.

Adjournment

Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business
described above are on file in the office of the City Manager, and available upon request by
emailing KManisco@malibucity.org.

The City Hall phone number is (310) 456-2489. To contact City Hall using a telecommunication
device for the deaf (TDD), please call (800) 735-2929 and a California Relay Service operator
will assist you. In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special
assistance to participate in this meeting, please contact Yolanda Bundy, Environmental
Sustainability Director, at (310) 456-2489, ext. 229. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting
will enable the City to make reasonable arrangements to ensure accessibility to this meeting. [28
CFR 35.102-35.104 ADD Title II].

I hereby certify under penalty of perjury, under the laws of the State of California that the
foregoing agenda was posted in accordance with the applicable legal requirements. Dated this 4th
day of March 2024 at 10:00 a.m.

  ______________________________
  Kate Manisco, Recreation Manager
